name: Pink Lakes

facts.claim: Salt lakes in Murray-Sunset National Park that turn pink in late summer from beta-carotene produced by the alga Dunaliella salina
The area was the site of a major salt industry from 1916 to 1975
Lake Becking campground is within the park

Several camping areas including Lake Hattah and Lake Mournpall

name: Wyperfeld National Park

facts.claim: Semi-arid national park in Victoria's north-west with a chain of lake beds linked by Outlet Creek, the northern extension of the Wimmera River
Reached via Hopetoun on the Henty Highway; sealed road from Rainbow or Hopetoun to Wonga Camping area
Co-managed with Wotjobaluk Traditional Owners (Barengi Gadjin Land Council)

name: Lake Tyrrell

facts.claim: Victoria's largest salt lake, about 20,860 ha, 6 km north of Sea Lake and 314 km north-west of Melbourne
Usually covered by about 5 cm of water in winter; in dry periods people can walk onto the salt crust

name: Pioneer Settlement

facts.claim: Open-air museum in Swan Hill that opened in 1966
Paddle steamer Gem runs the one-hour Pyap River Cruise
Evening laser light shows, Heartbeat of the Murray and Legends of the Mallee, run on set nights
